claims: The 2026 NHL regular season concludes on April 16.
The start date of the 2026 Stanley Cup Playoffs is tentatively April 18, 2026.
The 2026 Stanley Cup Playoffs consist of four rounds of best-of-seven series.
The 2026 Stanley Cup Playoffs use the 2–2–1–1–1 format.
16 teams qualify for the 2026 Stanley Cup Playoffs.
As of April 11, the Colorado Avalanche, Dallas Stars, Minnesota Wild, Edmonton Oilers, and Golden Knights have secured playoff berths.
As of April 11-12, in the Western Conference, the Avalanche hold the top Central spot.
As of April 11-12, in the Western Conference, the Stars have secured the No. 2 seed.
The Red Wings have recently been eliminated.
